privacy.metaDescription: How LOSTINSEOUL handles personal information for orders, inquiries, and limited releases.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lede: LOSTINSEOUL collects only the information needed to receive commitments, fulfill orders, answer inquiries, and keep release records accurate.

scope.title: Scope
scope.body: This notice covers the LOSTINSEOUL storefront, order flow, customer support, and release communications operated by Restored Projects.

data.title: Information
data.body: We may collect contact details, shipping details, order records, payment status, inquiry content, and technical logs needed to keep the storefront secure and usable.

use.title: Use
use.body: Information is used to process orders, prepare delivery, respond to support requests, prevent abuse, satisfy legal obligations, and improve release operations.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: We share information only with service providers required for payment, delivery, hosting, analytics, support, or legal compliance, and only to the extent needed for that work.

rights.title: Rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, deletion, suspension, or withdrawal where applicable. Some records may be retained when law, accounting, fraud prevention, or dispute handling requires it.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy requests, contact the privacy officer listed in the business information section below.

terms.metaDescription: Terms for using the LOSTINSEOUL storefront and purchasing limited Seoul objects.
terms.title: Terms
terms.lede: These terms cover access to the LOSTINSEOUL storefront, limited releases, commitments, orders, and related customer support.

service.title: Service
service.body: LOSTINSEOUL presents limited objects, editions, and commitments. Availability, release timing, imagery, specifications, and prices may change before an order is accepted.

orders.title: Orders
orders.body: An order or commitment is received when the storefront confirms it. We may cancel or refuse orders that cannot be fulfilled, appear abusive, or contain incorrect information.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Payment methods, currency, taxes, shipping fees, and confirmation steps are shown during checkout. Orders are fulfilled after payment or manual review is confirmed.

limits.title: Limits
limits.body: Limited releases may have quantity limits, delivery limits, manual allocation, or private-order requirements. Resale, automated purchasing, and abusive use may be restricted.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms as the storefront changes. The latest posted version applies to new visits, commitments, and orders.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about the service or an order can be sent through the contact address listed in the business information section below.

refund.metaDescription: Return, cancellation, and refund guidance for LOSTINSEOUL objects and limited releases.
refund.title: Returns
refund.lede: Returns and cancellations depend on the object type, production status, payment status, and whether the item has already shipped or been made for a specific order.

window.title: Before shipment
window.body: Orders that have not shipped or entered final production review may usually be cancelled after support confirms the order state.

custom.title: Custom work
custom.body: Made-to-order, private, altered, personalized, or otherwise custom objects may be non-refundable once production or sourcing begins.

shipping.title: After delivery
shipping.body: If an object arrives damaged, incorrect, or materially different from the confirmed order, contact us promptly with the order reference and photos so we can review replacement, return, or refund options.

process.title: Process
process.body: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method where possible. Manual payment refunds may require account details and additional confirmation.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.body: Return availability may be limited by hygiene, wear, missing components, damaged packaging, completed custom work, or legal restrictions.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Return and cancellation requests should be sent to the contact address listed in the business information section below.

Refunds.headline: In order to ensure your total satisfaction, a Customer or a recipient of a gift of The Hideaway products (a “Gift Recipient”) may return The Hideaway products in accordance with the return and exchange policy set forth below. Returns of The Hideaway products that are not in compliance with the conditions and timeframes set forth below may be rejected by The Hideaway and will be sent back to the Customer or Gift Recipient, as the case may be.

period.title: Return Period
period.body: The Hideaway products purchased through The Hideaway may be exchanged or returned for a refund or merchandise credit within seven (7) days following delivery. Please allow up to fourteen (14) business days for full refund, if applicable. Merchandise must be presented in its original packaging and accompanied by the appropriate sales receipt. Engraved, embossed, special order, personalized, made to order creations and items that show sign of wear cannot be exchanged or returned. All returns and exchanges are subject to the further terms and conditions set forth below.

process.title: Return Process
process.body: The Customer or Gift Recipient, as the case may be, must keep a proof of return shipment and the FedEx tracking number, and The Hideaway accepts no liability in the event that such proof cannot be produced. Only merchandise received by the The Hideaway distribution center will be eligible for a refund or exchange. Upon receiving a return, The Hideaway will verify that the returned product satisfies the conditions of the return policy and, if so, then proceed with the applicable refund or exchange.

conditions.title: Return Conditions
conditions.body: The Hideaway products must be returned in a new and unused state, in perfect condition, with all protective materials in place and tags and stickers attached to them (if applicable), as well as with the original The Hideaway box and delivery package, including all accessories and documents. The Hideaway will not accept any return if the product shows signs of wear, or has been used or altered from its original condition in any way. Engraved or embossed products, as well as special order, personalized and made-to-order creations, cannot be returned to The Hideaway for exchange, merchandise credit or refund. All returns will be subject to strict Quality Control (QC) by The Hideaway to ensure that the returned products satisfy these requirements. If the products do not meet QC standards, The Hideaway will refuse the return, and the products will be sent back to the Customer or the Gift Recipient, as applicable. If the returned product satisfies Quality Control (QC), The Hideaway will proceed with the applicable refund or exchange.

Invoice.refund: Items purchased from The Hideaway may be exchanged or returned for a refund within seven (7) days. Refunds are not guaranteed for items past seven (7) days from initial reception. The Hideaway products must be returned in a new and unused state, in perfect condition, with all packaging materials including the box and delivery package, with security tags and stickers attached, together with all related accessories and documents (if applicable). The Hideaway may refuse the return, or reduce the refund or exchange amount, if the product shows signs of wear, if the attached security tag has been removed, or if the product has been used or altered from its original condition in any way. Orders for personalized or made-to-order creations of any kind cannot be canceled, and such products cannot be returned for exchange or refund. This includes, but is not limited to, engraved or embossed products. All returns will be subject to strict Quality Control (QC) by The Hideaway to ensure that the returned products satisfy the above conditions. If a product does not meet QC standards, The Hideaway will refuse the return, and the product will be sent back to you. If the product satisfies QC standards, The Hideaway will proceed with the applicable refund or exchange. In the event of any failure to comply with these terms of sale, The Hideaway reserves the right to refuse receipt of the returned product and to send it back at your expense.

Invoice.terms: Physical products purchased from The Hideaway may be exchanged or returned for a refund within 7 days of receiving the goods. Returns of products past the initial week of reception will not be guaranteed. Refunds are only issued to the original purchaser via original method of payment. Product must be presented in its original packaging and accompanied by the appropriate sales documentation and International Limited Warranty. Non ready-made products which include, but are not limited to, items from: personalized orders; custom-ordered; airdropped and/or gifted, are void from any guarantee of refund or exchange. Items that show signs of wear also do not qualify for a return or an exchange. Before accepting any return or exchange, The Hideaway reserves its right to verify the product and proceed with necessary evaluations to confirm authenticity. Any services, products or other goods non-physical in form will not be eligible for refund.

intro.lede: A cookout turns into a room, and the room turns into a night.
intro.hosts: Hosted by Sean Choi & In Gyu Choe

details.title: What you are walking into.
details.body: A private rooftop-to-room gathering with food, drinks, music, and just enough structure to let the night move.
details.theme: Day into night. Blue and orange if you feel like leaning in.
details.dress: No strict dress code. The color note helps the room feel like one night.
details.contact: Hosts: Sean Choi and In Gyu Choe
details.price: 65,000 KRW · food, drinks, and entry included

potatoes.label: Before the Grill
potatoes.body: Brown-butter potatoes with sea salt and herbs. Simple, warm, rich.

grill.label: From the Grill
grill.body: Iberico pluma, ribs, and select Spanish pork cuts, grilled simply and served with the confidence expensive meat deserves. Buffalo wings and shrimp bring the loose rooftop energy back into the room.

pasta.label: Pasta
pasta.body: A simple aglio e olio, late if the night asks for it.

ferments.label: Ferments & Wine
ferments.body: Korean fruit and rice ferments, including I Am The Moon, Super Potion makgeolli, Isega, Maesil Wonju, and a little champagne.

cocktails.label: House Pours
cocktails.body: Cranberry highballs, lemon highballs, a light Seoul spritz, plum-and-soda pours, and whatever simple mix the room keeps asking for.

friends.title: Our friends
friends.caption: snaps from our shindigs in the past

music.body: A dear friend, GOAT barber, and most importantly — a killer DJ. YM.FM does not play background music; he turns the room into the reason you stayed.
music.assetNote: Drop YM.FM photos in /public/assets/daynnight before final image packing.

rsvp.body: Reserve your place and get added to the night.
rsvp.pendingBody: Your reservation is in. Check status from here.

opening.label: DAY
opening.lede: An intimate invited gathering that begins spread across the rooftop and ends drawn a little closer together.
opening.body: Day n Night is a private invited gathering in Haebangchon. While the light is still up, the rooftop opens into barbecue, fruit wine, reunions, and new introductions at an easy distance. By the time dusk settles in, everyone closes in a little more, and the night warms around music, conversation, and the kind of company you carry with you for years.

day.label: DAY
day.heading: Before dusk
day.body: Barbecue and fruit wine set the tone while people drift wide across the rooftop, settling into reunions, introductions, and the slower ease of early evening.

details.foodBody: A generous rooftop spread: grilled mains, small bites, fruit, and enough food to stay a while.
details.drinkBody: Beer, wine, fruit wine, and simple pours throughout the evening.
details.dressBody: Blue & orange. Not strict, but it helps the room feel like one night.
details.arrivalBody: Come early for the rooftop. Stay late for the room.

night.label: NIGHT
night.heading: After dusk
night.body: As the light falls, the room pulls closer. Voices rise, seats close in, and the night turns warmer around drinks, music, and company worth staying for.

dj.name: YM.FM
dj.role: Barber. Musician. Friend of the house.
